text: i think some of them are upside down and also a number of them are stretched, where u could tile it out a bit more [Image #6]
resolution: Fixed the void shell texture issues the user reported (upside-down + stretched). TILING: game/void/shell.ts now stacks each building from ~9m FACADE_TILE_METERS slabs instead of one monolith, so the facade texture repeats per floor instead of stretching a single tile over the whole tower; footprints cap to MAX_BUILDING_SPAN (22m) so the facade isn't smeared horizontally either — buildings read as proper narrower towers (confirmed via the void_probe self-shot). UPSIDE-DOWN: worldGeometry VOID_SHELL_FACADES curated to vertically-repeating looks only (window-grid apartments, fire-escapes, plain brick/concrete/stone/stucco/mildew/peel); dropped the ground-floor-specific shopfront/bodega/entrance/rollshutter whose storefront sits at one tile-end and reads wrong stacked up a tower. COLLIDERS: shell boxes now bake as a new render-only SHAPE_SCENERY_BOX so the multiplied stacked-tower count never feeds the windowed near-field collider rebuild (you walk past the horizon, not into it). Committed TS in f9addc7c8. NOTE 1: the loader half of SHAPE_SCENERY_BOX (world_loader.zig isNonCollidingFoliage) is in the working tree but NOT committed because session 06fe has unrelated uncommitted WIP in that same file — the bake is forward-compatible (an old loader renders shape 11 as a plain box via geomForShape fallback), so this is safe and just needs a clean loader commit later. NOTE 2: observed the loader clips 12150 collider rows hitting MAX_RECTS=16384 — that is the user's DENSE AUTHORED map's own baked piece colliders exceeding the cap (the baked-COLLIDERS branch derives nothing from shell instances), a PRE-EXISTING issue unrelated to the shell, but worth flagging (some authored walls may be walk-through). Verified: void.test.ts 9/9; bake + no-V8 render clean (grounded). The facade tiling/orientation look is compiled-material-only and the headless camera is locked to the player spawn, so the user verifies the final look in /compiled.
